lineNotes: As kuala-lumpur (same OSM route relations, one direction each, public line numbers from the Rapid KL / KTM / ERL network map), plus the Shah Alam Line (11, OSM relation 8394085, Johan Setia → Bandar Utama), which runs inside this wider box. The Skypark Link (10) is left out: the service is suspended. The ETS intercity trains and the KLIA Aerotrain are not part of the Klang Valley network map and are left out.

basemapNotes: The map comes in two files so the city shows first. data/basemap.json is box B of the owner's region preview (2026-11-24: Petaling Jaya, Subang, Shah Alam's east edge, Cheras, Ampang, Gombak; 2.98–3.28 N, 101.53–101.80 E) at full detail. data/basemap-outer.json is the rest of the box out to Klang, Rawang, Genting and KLIA, thinned since it is seen from far away: roads simplified 3 times wider and residential runs under 150 m left out. Only rendering detail is dropped; no value is estimated.

backdropNotes: A coarse, low-detail map around box D out to the horizon (pipeline/import-pbf-backdrop.mjs, then region:process): land from the OSM coastline, big forest and green areas, built-up areas (landuse residential, commercial, industrial, retail), large lakes and reservoirs, and motorways and trunk roads. Areas smaller than minAreaKm2 are left out and lines simplified by tolM; inside box D only the land is kept (D's own map is drawn there). The extract (Malaysia, Singapore, Brunei) has no Indonesian data, so Sumatra's coast across the Strait of Malacca is drawn as sea.
backdropRailNotes: Rail in the backdrop: the parts of these routes outside box D, cut at D's edge exactly where D's own lines end (the same route relation, chained the same way, from raw/overpass.json), so they join with no gap or overlap. ktm1 and ktm2 take their colour from the region's lines; ETS (KTM's intercity electric trains, relation 14979747 covers the whole Gemas – Padang Besar route) has no official line colour and is drawn thin and neutral, under the Komuter lines where they share the track. Left out: KTM Komuter Butterworth–Ipoh (only a few km near Ipoh at the far north edge, on the ETS track), the KLIA Aerotrain (inside the airport, in D), Skypark Link (suspended), and the East Coast Rail Link (under construction, no passenger service).
backdropExitNotes: backdrop.exits: lines that run on far past the map. Each gets a path from `from` (a stop on the route) to the terminus, for the website's direction labels at the screen edge, and the ordered stations past the edge of box D (OSM stop order; south of Gemas, OSM stations on the main line). `beyond` lists the stops past the end of OSM coverage (Thailand) with a cited source.
